displayName: Redis Cache should restrict external private endpoints in mission platforms
description: This policy applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. Restricting approved Redis Cache private endpoint connections to the current or explicitly excluded subscriptions helps prevent unauthorized cross-subscription access and data exfiltration.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
The subscription IDs allowed to host private endpoints connected to the Redis cache in addition to its own subscription.
